integrity: The packaged verifier reconstructs the graph from an LCF description, exhaustively enumerates all matchings, independently cross-checks matching counts by vertex deletion, and computes exact F2 boundary ranks. Literature comparison is relative to the checked sources and searches, with residual indexing risk stated.
scientific limitations: The claim determines only reduced homology over F2 for the ordinary matching complex of the standard Pappus graph. It does not determine integral torsion, simple connectivity, or the homotopy type.
title: Mod-2 homology of the Pappus matching complex
